entities.name: Víctor Zalazar
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Victor Zalazar was an Argentine boxer, who won the bronze medal at the 1956 Summer Olympics in Melbourne, Australia. He was born in La Paz, Córdoba. Zalazar was known as "El Cacique", or "The Wild Bullet".
